title: Before You Go

cues.en: I fell by the wayside, like everyone else
cues.zh: 我跌倒在路旁，就和所有人一樣
cues.text: I fell by the wayside, like everyone else

cues.en: I hate you, I hate you, I hate you
cues.zh: 我恨你，我恨你，我恨你
cues.text: I hate you, I hate you, I hate you

cues.en: But I was just kidding myself
cues.zh: 但我只是在開玩笑
cues.text: But I was just kidding myself

cues.en: Our every moment, I start to replace
cues.zh: 我們的每一刻，我都開始更換
cues.text: Our every moment, I start to replace

cues.en: 'Cause now that they're gone
cues.zh: 因為現在他們走了
cues.text: 'Cause now that they're gone

cues.en: All I hear are the words that I needed to say
cues.zh: 我所聽到的只是我需要說的話
cues.text: All I hear are the words that I needed to say

cues.en: When you hurt under the surface
cues.zh: 當你在水面下受傷時
cues.text: When you hurt under the surface

cues.en: Like troubled water running cold
cues.zh: 像麻煩水流涼
cues.text: Like troubled water running cold

cues.en: Well, time can heal, but this won't
cues.zh: 時間能治癒一切，但這段傷痛卻無法
cues.text: Well, time can heal, but this won't

cues.en: So, before you go
cues.zh: 所以在你走之前
cues.text: So, before you go

cues.en: Was there something I could've said
cues.zh: 我是否曾說錯了什麼話
cues.text: Was there something I could've said

cues.en: To make your heart beat better?
cues.zh: 讓你的心跳變得更好？
cues.text: To make your heart beat better?

cues.en: If only I'd have known you had a storm to weather
cues.zh: 要是我知道你有暴風雨天氣就好了
cues.text: If only I'd have known you had a storm to weather

cues.en: So, before you go
cues.zh: 所以在你走之前
cues.text: So, before you go

cues.en: Was there something I could've said

cues.text: Was there something I could've said

cues.en: To make it all stop hurting?
cues.zh: 能讓這一切痛苦停止嗎？
cues.text: To make it all stop hurting?

cues.en: It kills me how your mind can make you feel so worthless
cues.zh: 你的頭腦怎麼會讓你覺得一文不值
cues.text: It kills me how your mind can make you feel so worthless

cues.en: Went little, by little, by little until there was nothing at all
